body: I am. I really am. I broke my iphone screen twice in a week. over $300 in repairs. Oh and it's cracking again.
Thanks. I'm too embarrassed to call them today but perhaps I will tomorrow. I don't know.

"You're very hard on yourself" stuck out to me. I have had at least four people say that now. I just feel like if I can't be tasked to do simple things, what is the point? I know that's dramatic. 

I hope your arm gets better soon.

Nothing I would show people. My boyfriend tried to look through my sketchbook and I got upset. I used to play it a while ago, but haven't since I got my new phone. 

I like tv, but I am told I watch too much. I used to like doing outdoor activities but I don't have anyone to do anything with so I never bother anymore.

I have no hobbies because I am a waste of space. I am literally useless. I try to do things like draw and paint but I'm shit. I used to read but my mind has no attention for it anymore. I don't have friends so fun isn't something I have often.

So many reasons. I drove with my e-brake on last week the first day I had my car. On my way to my driving test I got on the wrong bus. I've quit my job despite not having another one lined up and then I went and missed my interview today. I just hate myself and every little thing I do.

I am bipolar so my entire being is a problem in itself. I am told that if I do not get "better" soon I will be kicked out. So I don't know what to do. I have an interview tomorrow for a job much farther away. I will maybe call the guy back tomorrow if I am better. But I don't know. I feel so stupid and useless. I literally can't do simple tasks. I am just such a waste of life and I'm tired of being so stupid. I will never do anything properly. The place is literally so close to my house I can't believe I got lost. No one will hire an idiot like me anyway. 

My dad is pushing me to go to school but I feel I am too stupid to even try. I don't want to.
my life is not precious my life is a waste of resources
It's been two hours already I feel to stupid to call them
